olivia.marketing: Quick sprint: tighten landing hero copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private and confirm CTA -> routing (webinar/demo/start). Keep CTAs developer-first and call out price/latency where relevant. Drop 1 variant each pls.
maria.copy: Hosted: 'Hosted API — integrate in minutes, pay per call.' subhead: 'Curated models and predictable pricing.'
sam.growth: Hosted alt (metric): 'Avg gen latency ~45ms (512 tok) — prototype faster.' We'll A/B test metric vs benefit.
tariq.ops: Dedicated: 'Dedicated capacity — reserved GPUs, predictable throughput.' sub: 'Autoscale and SLA-backed latency.' Private: 'Private deployment — VPC or on-prem with KMS.' sub: 'Compliance controls and audit logs.'
ben.salesbot: Routing: Join webinar -> growth@, Request demo -> sales@, Start free -> onboarding@. I'll tag leads with product_mode and cta_type.
olivia.marketing: Great. Maria add char counts and mark primaries. Sam set AB test, Tariq share fallback (if growth queue > 150 -> route webinar to nurture). Review Wed 9:30 PT. :+1:
